acquisition.qualification: Each sample time is the interval between host call start and response completion, mapped through MCU estimated print time. It does not identify ADC conversion time or bound cached-conversion age.
acquisition.retained_timebase: Sample start/end offsets are estimated MCU print times relative to capture_start; host monotonic absolute times are removed. call_duration values are measured from host monotonic time.
acquisition.sampling_rule: Request one synchronous cache read per requested poll period until estimated MCU print time reaches capture_end; host stalls may create local cadence gaps followed by catch-up reads.

cleanup.final: CLEAR_OOZE, CLEAR_FLUSH, heater target zero, full G28, absolute Z=200, return to trash
cleanup.intermediate: CLEAR_FLUSH and return to trash after no more than two measured pulses
cleanup.ordinary_e_move_result: physical nominal E advanced exactly 1.0 mm after direct-pulse rebasing; logical E returned to 0.0

qualification: Four stationary pulses produced live force-correlated origin-cache responses without changing XYZ, pressure advance, smoothing, logical E, or filament source. This establishes under-force feasibility only. Cache age, deterministic conversion alignment, invalid-read classification, and candidate repeatability remain unresolved; public and developer capture remain disabled.
